## String, bytes and math functions
# Each case is an edge where DuckDB's counterpart answers differently from BigQuery.

SELECT CHR(0)
=> ""

SELECT CHR(12354)
=> "あ"

SELECT UNICODE('')
=> "0"

SELECT UNICODE('あ')
=> "12354"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(TO_CODE_POINTS('aあ😀\n')) AS x), ',')
=> "97,12354,128512,10"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(TO_CODE_POINTS(b'\x00a\xff')) AS x), ',')
=> "0,97,255"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(TO_CODE_POINTS(''))
=> "0"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(TO_CODE_POINTS(raw)) FROM t WHERE a = 3
=> "2"

SELECT CODE_POINTS_TO_STRING([97, 12354, 128512])
=> "aあ😀"

SELECT CODE_POINTS_TO_STRING(TO_CODE_POINTS(b)) FROM t WHERE a = 3
=> "あ"

SELECT CODE_POINTS_TO_STRING([])
=> ""

SELECT CODE_POINTS_TO_STRING([97, NULL])
=> null

SELECT SAFE.CODE_POINTS_TO_STRING([97, 55296])
=> null

SELECT SAFE.CODE_POINTS_TO_STRING([1114112])
=> null

SELECT TO_HEX(CODE_POINTS_TO_BYTES([0, 97, 255]))
=> "0061ff"

SELECT TO_HEX(CODE_POINTS_TO_BYTES(TO_CODE_POINTS(raw))) FROM t WHERE a = 3
=> "00ff"

SELECT CODE_POINTS_TO_BYTES([97, NULL])
=> null

SELECT SAFE.CODE_POINTS_TO_BYTES([256])
=> null

SELECT ASCII('A')
=> "65"

SELECT INSTR('abcb', 'b')
=> "2"

SELECT LEFT('abc', 2) || RIGHT('abc', 1)
=> "abc"

SELECT TRANSLATE('abc', 'ab', 'x')
=> "xc"

SELECT TO_HEX(TRANSLATE(b'\x00ab\xff', b'a\xff', b'\x01'))
=> "000162"

SELECT TO_HEX(b'\x00\xff')
=> "00ff"

SELECT TO_HEX(FROM_HEX('A'))
=> "0a"

SELECT TO_HEX(MD5('a'))
=> "0cc175b9c0f1b6a831c399e269772661"

SELECT BYTE_LENGTH(SHA256('a'))
=> "32"

SELECT TO_BASE64(FROM_BASE64('AP8='))
=> "AP8="

# Base32 is RFC 4648's, padded; BigQuery's documentation and GoogleSQL's compliance test data.
SELECT TO_BASE32(b'abcde\xFF')
=> "MFRGGZDF74======"

SELECT TO_HEX(FROM_BASE32('MFRGGZDF74======'))
=> "6162636465ff"

SELECT TO_BASE32(b'')
=> ""

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT TO_BASE32(x) FROM UNNEST([b'1', b'1a', b'12345', b'123456', b'1234567890123456']) x WITH OFFSET o ORDER BY o), ',')
=> "GE======,GFQQ====,GEZDGNBV,GEZDGNBVGY======,GEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQGEZDGNBVGY======"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(FROM_BASE32(x) AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(['GE======', 'GFQQ====', 'GEZDGNBV', 'GEZDGNBVGY======', 'GEZDGNBVGY3TQOJQGEZDGNBVGY======']) x WITH OFFSET o ORDER BY o), ',')
=> "1,1a,12345,123456,1234567890123456"

SELECT TO_HEX(FROM_BASE32(''))
=> ""

# FROM_BASE32 accepts lower case and unpadded text, but not partial padding; BigQuery's answers.
SELECT TO_HEX(SAFE.FROM_BASE32('mfrgg==='))
=> "616263"

SELECT TO_HEX(SAFE.FROM_BASE32('MFRGG'))
=> "616263"

SELECT TO_HEX(SAFE.FROM_BASE32('MFRGG='))
=> null

SELECT TO_BASE32(CAST(NULL AS BYTES))
=> null

SELECT FROM_BASE32(CAST(NULL AS STRING))
=> null

SELECT SAFE.FROM_BASE32('GE0')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.FROM_BASE32('12')
=> null

SELECT CAST(IEEE_DIVIDE(1, 0) AS STRING)
=> "inf"

SELECT BIT_COUNT(-1)
=> "64"

SELECT BIT_COUNT(b'\xff\x01')
=> "9"

SELECT BIT_COUNT(b'')
=> "0"

SELECT BIT_COUNT(raw) FROM t WHERE a = 2
=> null

SELECT CAST(CBRT(8) AS INT64)
=> "2"

SELECT CAST(ATAN2(1, 1) * 4 * 1000 AS INT64)
=> "3142"

SELECT SAFE_ADD(9223372036854775807, 1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE_MULTIPLY(a, 2) FROM t WHERE a = 3
=> "6"

SELECT SAFE_NEGATE(1)
=> "-1"

SELECT SAFE_SUBTRACT(1, 2)
=> "-1"

## SUBSTR at BigQuery positions

SELECT SUBSTR('abc', 0, 2)
=> "ab"

SELECT SUBSTR('abc', -5, 2)
=> "ab"

SELECT SUBSTR('abc', -2)
=> "bc"

SELECT SUBSTRING('あいう', 2, 1)
=> "い"

SELECT SUBSTR('abc', 4)
=> ""

## String functions on bytes
# A byte that is not valid UTF-8 must stay whole.

SELECT TO_HEX(LEFT(b'\xffab', 2))
=> "ff61"

SELECT TO_HEX(RIGHT(b'\xffab', 1))
=> "62"

SELECT SAFE.LEFT(b'abc', -1)
=> null

SELECT TO_HEX(SUBSTR(b'\xffab', 2))
=> "6162"

SELECT TO_HEX(SUBSTR(b'\xffab', 0, 2))
=> "ff61"

SELECT TO_HEX(SUBSTRING(b'\xffab', -2, 1))
=> "61"

SELECT TO_HEX(REVERSE(b'\x01\xffa'))
=> "61ff01"

SELECT TO_HEX(LOWER(b'\\\xffAz'))
=> "5cff617a"

SELECT TO_HEX(UPPER(b'\\\xffAz'))
=> "5cff415a"

SELECT TO_HEX(LPAD(b'a', 4, b'\xff'))
=> "ffffff61"

SELECT TO_HEX(RPAD(b'a', 2))
=> "6120"

SELECT TO_HEX(LPAD(b'abc', 2))
=> "6162"

SELECT TO_HEX(TRIM(b'\xffa\xffb\xff', b'\xff'))
=> "61ff62"

SELECT TO_HEX(LTRIM(b'aab', b'a'))
=> "62"

SELECT TO_HEX(RTRIM(b'abb', b'ab'))
=> ""

SELECT TO_HEX(REPLACE(b'\x1f\xf1\xff', b'\xff', b'z'))
=> "1ff17a"

SELECT TO_HEX(REPLACE(b'abc', b'', b'z'))
=> "616263"

SELECT INSTR(b'abcb', b'b', 1, 2)
=> "4"

SELECT INSTR(b'abcb', b'b', -1)
=> "4"

SELECT ARRAY_LENGTH(SPLIT(b'', b','))
=> "1"

SELECT TO_HEX(ARRAY_TO_STRING([b'a', NULL, b'\xff'], b'-'))
=> "612dff"

SELECT TO_HEX(ARRAY_TO_STRING([b'a', NULL], b'-', b'\xff'))
=> "612dff"

SELECT STRPOS(b'\x1f\xf1\xff', b'\xff')
=> "3"

SELECT INSTR(b'abc', b'z')
=> "0"

SELECT STARTS_WITH(b'\xffa', b'\xff')
=> "true"

SELECT ENDS_WITH(b'\xffa', b'\xff')
=> "false"

SELECT ASCII(b'\xffa')
=> "255"

SELECT ASCII(b'')
=> "0"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT TO_HEX(x) FROM UNNEST(SPLIT(b'a\x1f\xf1b', b'\xf1')) AS x), ',')
=> "611f,62"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT TO_HEX(x) FROM UNNEST(SPLIT(b'a\xff', b'')) AS x), ',')
=> "61,ff"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(['a', NULL, 'b'], '-', 'N')
=> "a-N-b"

SELECT TO_HEX(STRING_AGG(raw ORDER BY a)) FROM t
=> "612c00ff"

SELECT TO_HEX(STRING_AGG(raw, b'' ORDER BY a DESC LIMIT 1)) FROM t
=> "00ff"

## GoogleSQL functions
# src/backend_functions.cc registers GoogleSQL's implementations of these.

SELECT FARM_FINGERPRINT('')
=> "-7286425919675154353"

SELECT FARM_FINGERPRINT('あ') = FARM_FINGERPRINT(b'\xe3\x81\x82')
=> "true"

SELECT FARM_FINGERPRINT(CAST(NULL AS STRING))
=> null

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT FARM_FINGERPRINT(raw)) FROM t
=> "2"

SELECT TO_HEX(SHA512('abc'))
=> "ddaf35a193617abacc417349ae20413112e6fa4e89a97ea20a9eeee64b55d39a2192992a274fc1a836ba3c23a3feebbd454d4423643ce80e2a9ac94fa54ca49f"

SELECT SHA512(b'\xff') = SHA512(FROM_HEX('ff'))
=> "true"

SELECT INITCAP('hello WORLD-everyone!')
=> "Hello World-Everyone!"

## GoogleSQL string functions
# Each case is an edge where DuckDB's counterpart answers differently from BigQuery.

SELECT UPPER('straße')
=> "STRASSE"

SELECT LOWER('ΑΣ')
=> "ας"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(TO_CODE_POINTS(REVERSE('a\u0301b'))) AS x), ',')
=> "98,769,97"

SELECT REVERSE(b) FROM t WHERE a IS NULL
=> null

SELECT TRIM(' \t\u3000a\n')
=> "a"

SELECT LTRIM('\u00a0a ') || RTRIM(' a\u2003')
=> "a  a"

SELECT TRIM('xax', 'x')
=> "a"

SELECT SAFE.TRANSLATE('abca', 'aa', 'xy')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.TRANSLATE(b'abca', b'aa', b'xy')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.TRANSLATE(REPEAT('a', 1048576), 'a', 'é') IS NULL
=> "true"

SELECT SAFE.REPLACE(REPEAT('a', 1048576), 'a', 'aa') IS NULL
=> "true"

SELECT ASCII('')
=> "0"

SELECT SAFE.ASCII('é')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.LEFT('abc', -1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.RIGHT('abc', -1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.LPAD('abc', 5, '')
=> null

SELECT SAFE.RPAD('abc', -1)
=> null

SELECT SAFE.LPAD('a', 1048577) IS NULL
=> "true"

SELECT RPAD('あ', 3, 'い')
=> "あいい"

SELECT INSTR('abcb', 'b', 1, 2)
=> "4"

SELECT INSTR('abcb', 'b', -1, 2)
=> "2"

SELECT SAFE.INSTR('abc', 'b', 0)
=> null

SELECT NORMALIZE('\uff21\u2460', NFKC)
=> "A1"

SELECT ARRAY_TO_STRING(ARRAY(SELECT CAST(x AS STRING) FROM UNNEST(TO_CODE_POINTS(NORMALIZE('\u00e9', NFD))) AS x), ',')
=> "101,769"

SELECT NORMALIZE_AND_CASEFOLD('Straße', NFKC)
=> "strasse"

SELECT CONTAINS_SUBSTR('the blue house', 'Blue')
=> "true"

SELECT CONTAINS_SUBSTR('\uff21bc', 'a')
=> "true"

SELECT CONTAINS_SUBSTR('abc', '')
=> "true"

SELECT CONTAINS_SUBSTR('abc', 'd')
=> "false"

SELECT CONTAINS_SUBSTR(b, 'x') FROM t WHERE a IS NULL
=> null

SELECT INITCAP('apples1oranges2pears', '12')
=> "Apples1Oranges2Pears"

SELECT EDIT_DISTANCE('kitten', 'sitting')
=> "3"

SELECT EDIT_DISTANCE('あい', 'いあ')
=> "2"

SELECT EDIT_DISTANCE('kitten', 'sitting', max_distance => 2)
=> "2"

SELECT EDIT_DISTANCE(b'\xe3\x81\x82', b'\xe3\x81\x84')
=> "1"

SELECT REGEXP_INSTR('ab@cd-ef', '@[^-]*')
=> "3"

SELECT REGEXP_INSTR('あいう', 'う')
=> "3"

SELECT REGEXP_INSTR('-2020-jack-class1', '-[^.-]*', 2, 1, 0)
=> "6"

SELECT REGEXP_INSTR('-2020-jack-class1', '-[^.-]*', 2, 1, 1)
=> "11"

SELECT REGEXP_INSTR('abc', 'z')
=> "0"

SELECT REGEXP_INSTR(b'\xe3\x81\x82b', b'b')
=> "4"

SELECT REGEXP_INSTR('abc', 'b', NULL)
=> null

SELECT SOUNDEX('Ashcraft')
=> "A261"

SELECT SOUNDEX('あ')
=> ""

SELECT SOUNDEX(CAST(NULL AS STRING))
=> null

SELECT SAFE_CONVERT_BYTES_TO_STRING(b'\xc2')
=> "�"

SELECT SAFE_CONVERT_BYTES_TO_STRING(CAST(NULL AS BYTES))
=> null
